text: Today is the auspicious Masa Shivaratri.
On this sacred day, it is especially beneficial to perform worship during Pradosha-time.
You can offer an evening abhishekam to a Shiva Lingam with water or milk.
If a Shiva Lingam is not available, light a deepam before a picture of Lord Shiva.
Chant the sacred mantra 'Om Namah Shivaya' 108 times.
If available, offering Bilva leaves is considered very auspicious.
